discussion.body: Temple of Fire. Seat: north massif under the World Cannon, above Maze Fissure. World aspect: heat, forge, volcanic breath, the sealed hunger. This is Nyxara's door, not her throne. Sigil: Cinder. Combat: burn, overheat, trance shorten. Civic: Constium forges stay lit without eating the mountain. Failure / corruption: prayers to Fire start answering in Nyxara's voice; Orc Invasion worsens because the NE woods cook and drive people; Cannon ignition becomes possible. Relation: Fire is the aspect Vortan wants to weaponize and Velith wants to smother. The correct use is a banked coal that holds the Fissure shut. Party link: Ash walks this border; Brann reads this barrel.
